description: Our team combines technical knowledge, creativity, problem solving, and scientific thinking to develop innovative solutions for challenges related to space exploration.Our project focuses on developing a health monitoring solution for astronauts, using technology and data to track vital health indicators and support astronaut well being during space missions.
summary: AstroViva was developed to address the NASA Health Monitoring Challenge by providing an integrated solution for monitoring and protecting astronauts’ health during space missions. We chose this challenge because it perfectly matched our team’s diverse engineering and programming skills and gave us the opportunity to apply technology to a real-world problem. Throughout development, we worked on building a health-monitoring system using code to analyze astronauts’ manually entered health data and identify potential health risks. We also developed an offline AI chatbot to provide psychological support and guidance, and explored live-streaming capabilities to enable real-time health monitoring. AstroViva is important because astronauts face unique health challenges in space, including changes in heart rate, sleep patterns, and overall physical and mental well-being. By combining health analysis, early risk prediction, psychological support, and real-time monitoring, AstroViva aims to help detect potential problems before they become serious, improve astronauts’ safety, and support healthier and longer space missions.
details:
AstroViva is an integrated astronaut health-monitoring system designed to support crew safety and well-being during space missions. Our project combines health data analysis, early risk prediction, psychological support, and real-time monitoring into one platform.

The system allows astronauts to enter health measurements, such as heart rate and blood pressure, which are analyzed by our program to identify abnormal values and potential health risks. We also developed an offline chatbot that provides astronauts with psychological support and guidance, ensuring accessibility even without an internet connection. Additionally, we incorporated live-streaming capabilities to support real-time health monitoring and communication.

We used several programming technologies to develop AstroViva, including Python for data processing, health analysis, and risk prediction; HTML for structuring the user interface; and JavaScript for interactive features and dynamic functionality. These technologies helped us build an integrated and accessible system.

AstroViva’s creativity lies in combining physical health monitoring with mental health support in a unified platform. Our main goal is to contribute to early detection of health risks, improve astronauts’ quality of life, and support safer and more sustainable long-duration space missions.
